_instructions: Copy this block into family_offices.json for each new office. Fill what you verify; leave null what you can't. Every high-value cell needs a real source. Never invent a 'verified' contact.

fo_type.source: URL of proof (NOT the discovery source)
fo_type.evidence: short paraphrase of what the source says

aum.note: e.g. 'not disclosed' or a range if sources disagree

discovered_via: which trail surfaced it (EDGAR form X / ProPublica 990-PF)
proof_source: the SECOND, independent source that confirmed it
